algorithm: visit bookmakers in frozen hierarchy order
choose first bookmaker with at least one structurally complete in-window bundle
within that bookmaker choose latest structurally complete bundle at or before cutoff
only after bookmaker and bundle are fixed apply odds, overround, devig-sensitivity and CDF-coherence gates
if selected bookmaker/bundle fails a price or coherence gate ABSTAIN; never fall through to a lower-ranked bookmaker or older bundle
bookmaker_selection.origin: existing preregistered BENCHMARK_HIERARCHY in prospective odds_capture.py
bookmaker_selection.selection_basis: structural availability only; never probability, price attractiveness, disagreement magnitude or outcome
bookmaker_selection.structurally_complete_corner_surface: at least 3 adjacent registered lines, each with OVER and UNDER, in one in-window bundle
bookmaker_selection.structurally_complete_goal_market: both OVER and UNDER at registered line 2.5 in one in-window bundle

incremental_information_experiment.fit_select_data: pre-prospective matched market rows only; legacy exposed 317 cannot serve as confirmatory evaluation
incremental_information_experiment.model: regularized logistic stack of logit(primary p_market) and logit(frozen p_model)
incremental_information_experiment.primary_question: does adding frozen QFE p_model improve OOS Log Loss over market-only comparator

CORNERS_SIDE.reason: Primary capture source lacks registered team-corner concepts and provider-to-bookmaker corner settlement equivalence is unverified.

CORNERS_TOTAL.reason: Provider-to-bookmaker corner settlement equivalence is unverified; model probabilities may be produced but bookmaker comparison must abstain.

GOALS_TOTAL.reason: Layer 4 calibrated goals only at total 2.5; no multi-line calibrated goal surface is claimed.

line_selection.goals_total_2_5: only registered line; no surface-corroboration claim
surface_algorithm: determine model-favoured side from cleaned signed gap
find contiguous runs with same direction, every line abs gap >= supporting threshold, at least one line abs gap >= selected-line threshold
discard runs shorter than minimum adjacent corroborating lines
discard surface if an opposite-direction strong gap exists elsewhere
choose run whose member has cleaned market probability closest to 0.50; tie by lower starting line
within chosen run choose line whose selected-side cleaned market probability is closest to 0.50; tie by numeric distance to run median line, then lower line

market_horizon.selection: latest complete bookmaker quote bundle observed at or before prediction_cutoff

optional_calibrated_challenger.eligibility: only if at least 250 matched unique pre-protected fixtures exist in the relevant calibration group
optional_calibrated_challenger.role_in_disagreement_policy: diagnostic benchmark only; never replaces primary no-vig p_market for eligibility
optional_calibrated_challenger.selection_metric: fixture-balanced Log Loss with Brier non-inferiority

market_source.legacy_alert_quote_stream: coverage-audit-only; never used for prospective evaluation
market_source.legacy_clv_panel: coverage-audit-only; never used for prospective evaluation
market_source.required_identity: canonical_entity_id must equal the frozen future prospective cohort fixture id
market_source.timestamp_semantics: QFE-owned retrieval/observation timestamp; provider last_seen without source timestamp is forbidden

model_support_gate.reliability_adjusted_gap_definition: abs(p_model-p_market)-reliability_penalty; this is an eligibility diagnostic, NOT a fixture probability confidence bound
model_support_gate.reliability_penalty: max(abs(ci_low),abs(ci_high)) from Layer4 empirical calibration-bin reliability-error band

prospective_evaluation.disagreement_scorecard: only new prospective rows selected by the frozen v1.2 policy
prospective_evaluation.global_scorecard: all new prospective rows with frozen p_model and settled outcome, irrespective of disagreement eligibility
prospective_evaluation.historical_manifest_use: implementation/coverage regression only; never final scoring
prospective_evaluation.market_scorecard: only new prospective rows with valid registered market comparator
